notes.title: Patch 2.034 Notes
notes.notes: [p]Kando Realm Patch 2.034 Patch Notes: Releasing today![/p][p][/p][h3]😍 NEW CONTENT ALERT! 😍 [/h3][p]New Large nodes for Herbalism have been added[/p][p]Party windows now let you select different loot modes for your party[/p][p][/p][h3]⚖️ BALANCING ⚖️ [/h3][p]Frosty has had another balance rework[/p][p][/p][h3]🛠️ BUG FIXES 🛠️ [/h3][p]Personal loot now works in a party[/p][p]Updated font on player stat bars[/p][p]Game now opens in full screen the first time on a new install[/p][p]Needs Ammo message now shows in chat when you don't have the required Ammo equipped[/p]
